name: OverviewPageTemplate
need: The overview/dashboard archetype has NO carrier: airun's cockpit hand-assembles PageHeader + a page-content div, Salim's prototype s10 and the ai-maturity dashboards are the same shape outside the monorepo, and every 'make me a dashboard' request lands on an archetype with no template and no example — the most common generation failure the golden-screens inventory found.

consideredAlternatives.whyNot: A list has one collection and a toolbar that narrows it; an overview has priority bands and a grid of self-contained widgets with no filters. Forcing it produced the hand-rolled cockpit.
Detail is one record in sections with an aside; an overview is many sources at a glance. The aside contract has no meaning here.
That is the status quo: the cockpit composed it by hand, correctly, once — and the next dashboard starts from zero instead of from the pattern.

proposedApi.OverviewPageTemplate: title, actions (freshness lives here, never under the title), notices (conditional, nothing when healthy), band (time/context strip), prime (what is read first, full width), children (the widget grid), isEmpty + empty (no-data only: an overview has no filters)
proposedApi.OverviewWidget: title, action, footer (the 'view all' line via CardMeta), wide, children — one fixed anatomy so a grid of widgets reads as one surface

sources: airun CockpitPage (live case: notices/band/board zone order), Cloudscape service dashboard (three priority bands, one widget anatomy, ~seven visual elements), SAP Fiori OVP (typed card grid)
decision: Build as a block per the golden-screens G1 batch: the archetype gap is real, three live cases exist, and the API above is the consolidation of what the cockpit already proved.
